title: GPT-5.5 Instant launches with smarter, clearer responses and better personalization
summary: GPT-5.5 Instant launches with improved factuality, producing 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims than GPT-5.3 Instant. Features memory sources giving users visibility and control over personalization context.

title: OpenAI launches three realtime voice models: GPT-Realtime-2, Translate, and Whisper
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-Realtime-2 with GPT-5-class reasoning for voice interactions, GPT-Realtime-Translate supporting 70+ languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for low-latency streaming transcription.

title: OpenAI launches dedicated Codex Chrome extension for browser AI workflows
summary: OpenAI launches a dedicated Chrome extension for Codex, enabling AI-powered browser workflows and web automation directly from the browser.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 launches as Anthropic's most capable generally available model
summary: Claude Opus 4.7 launches with 13% resolution improvement over Opus 4.6 on coding benchmarks, enhanced vision supporting 2,576 pixel images, and new xhigh effort level for complex agentic tasks.

title: Anthropic launches financial services agents with ten ready-to-run templates
summary: Anthropic releases ten agent templates for financial services including pitch builder, KYC screener, and month-end closer. Claude now works across Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook via Microsoft 365 add-ins.

title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite now generally available, Google's fastest and most cost-efficient model
summary: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Google's fastest and most cost-efficient Gemini 3 series model, is now generally available on Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform at $0.25/1M input tokens.

title: Google launches Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 with enhanced spatial reasoning for robots
summary: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 launches with improved spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding, enabling robots to read gauges, detect success in tasks, and operate with unprecedented precision in physical environments.

title: Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-agent launch in Enterprise API with 2M token context
summary: Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-agent launch in Enterprise API featuring 4-agent collaborative architecture and 2 million token context window for complex agentic workflows.

title: xAI deprecated models guide: Grok 3 and grok-4 series retire May 15
summary: xAI provides migration guide for May 15 retirement of grok-3, grok-4-fast, grok-4-1-fast, and grok-code-fast-1. All retired models redirect to grok-4.3 with updated pricing.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni unifies vision, audio and language for 9x more efficient AI agents
summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni launches as an open omnimodal reasoning model bringing unified text, image, audio, and video understanding to AI agents with up to 9x higher throughput than comparable models.

title: NVIDIA releases Star Elastic: one checkpoint contains 30B, 23B, and 12B reasoning models
summary: NVIDIA releases Star Elastic enabling zero-shot slicing of a single 30B reasoning model into 23B and 12B variants. Uses Router-Weighted Expert Activation Pruning for efficient nested submodel extraction.

title: Meta releases Llama 4 with native multimodal vision and 10M token context
summary: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick as first open-weight natively multimodal models with early fusion architecture. Llama 4 Scout supports industry-leading 10 million token context window.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro launches as open-source with 1M token context and SOTA agentic coding
summary: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T total / 49B active params) launches as open-source with 1M token context. Achieves open-source SOTA in Agentic Coding benchmarks, outperforming all other open models.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash launches at $0.14 per million input tokens
summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B total / 13B active) launches at $0.14 per million input tokens, making it one of the cheapest frontier-class models with reasoning capabilities rivaling V4-Pro.

title: MiniMax M2.7 launches as latest flagship with 236B parameters and improved benchmarks
summary: MiniMax M2.7 launches (May 15, 2026) with 236B parameters, 200K context, improved multimodal reasoning, and open-source weights under Modified-MIT. Achieves 86.5% MMLU, 80.5% LiveBench with enhanced agentic capabilities.

title: MiniMax M2.1 achieves state-of-the-art coding performance among open-source models
summary: MiniMax M2.1 achieves #1 ranking on Hot Arena leaderboard among open-source models with 230B total parameters and ~10B activated. Excels in agent scenarios with production-ready engineering capabilities.

title: MiniMax Speech 2.5 launches with enhanced multilingual expressiveness and voice cloning
summary: MiniMax Speech 2.5 launches with significantly enhanced multilingual performance, realistic voice cloning across 40+ languages, and improved natural rhythm eliminating robotic feel common in other TTS systems.

title: MiniMax Hailuo 02 video generation launches with record-breaking cost efficiency
summary: MiniMax Hailuo 02 launches with Noise-aware Compute Redistribution architecture achieving 2.5x training efficiency. Ranks second globally on Artificial Analysis Video Arena with native 1080p generation.

title: Apple iOS 27 will let users choose between Gemini, Claude, and more for AI features
summary: iOS 27 will allow users to choose from multiple third-party AI models including Claude, Gemini, and Grok to power Apple Intelligence features, marking a significant opening of Apple's AI ecosystem.

title: Mistral releases Medium 3.5, a 128B dense open-weight model replacing three prior products
summary: Mistral releases Medium 3.5, a 128B dense open-weight model scoring 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified. Replaces three prior products and offers improved code generation and reasoning capabilities.

title: Mistral launches Vibe remote coding agents that open pull requests when done
summary: Mistral launches Vibe remote coding agents running in cloud sandboxes that can autonomously open pull requests when tasks complete. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5 for enterprise coding workflows.

title: ByteDance releases Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite, first full-modal understanding model
summary: ByteDance releases Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite, the first full-modal understanding model achieving native unified understanding of video, images, audio, and text in a single architecture.

title: Alibaba releases Qwen3.6-27B dense model scoring 77.2 on SWE-bench Verified
summary: Alibaba releases Qwen3.6-27B, a dense open-weight model scoring 77.2 on SWE-bench Verified. First dense model in Qwen3.6 family with Apache 2.0 license for commercial use.

title: Anthropic Claude Code introduces UltraReview slash command for comprehensive code review
summary: Anthropic Claude Code introduces /ultrareview command that reads through code changes and flags bugs and design issues. Pro and Max users get three free ultrareviews to start.

title: Samsung Gauss 2 enters limited release for Galaxy S26 AI features
summary: Samsung Gauss 2 enters limited release powering Galaxy S26 AI features with on-device inference. The model offers improved Korean language processing and reduced latency for local AI tasks.

title: Kimi launches K2.6 with 1M context and enhanced long-context reasoning
summary: Kimi launches K2.6 with native 1 million token context and improved reasoning capabilities. Excels in document summarization and multi-turn conversations with extended context retention.

title: 01.AI launches K2 Think V2 with improved reasoning and function calling
summary: 01.AI launches K2 Think V2 with enhanced chain-of-thought reasoning and improved function calling capabilities. Supports 256K context window for enterprise applications.

title: Microsoft Copilot gains GPT-5.5 Turbo integration with enhanced reasoning
summary: Microsoft integrates GPT-5.5 Turbo into Copilot for Microsoft 365 enterprise users. Offers improved document drafting, meeting summarization, and cross-application context awareness.

title: Amazon Nova 2.0 Pro Preview launches with enhanced multimodal capabilities
summary: Amazon Nova 2.0 Pro Preview launches on AWS with improved multimodal understanding and longer context. Powers Amazon Q Business with enhanced enterprise AI capabilities.

title: Oracle OCI Generative AI adds Claude models with enterprise SLA
summary: Oracle OCI Generative AI adds Anthropic Claude models to its enterprise AI portfolio with dedicated infrastructure and SLA guarantees. Targets regulated industries requiring data sovereignty.

title: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.1 with improved reasoning and 256K context
summary: Zhipu AI releases GLM-5.1, an open-weight model with 130B parameters and 256K context window. Achieves competitive performance on math and reasoning benchmarks.

title: Samsung Gauss 2 enters limited release for Galaxy S26 AI features
summary: Samsung Gauss 2 enters limited release powering Galaxy S26 AI features with on-device inference. The model offers improved Korean language processing and reduced latency for local AI tasks.
